purpose: the placement test of a new harness, as the authorization requires before it joins: its first host run must be BIT_IDENTICAL to its laptop run of the same population, and a dated addendum names it

harness.what: E2b (REPORT 41.15): _l3d_e2.py with the arms XT and P dropped and the arms UAG (UA where the lexical schedule is non-empty, else LEX), UF (the fill union: the lexical candidates first, then the appended walk's new ones, in its own order) and UFG (UF where the lexical schedule is non-empty, else LEX) added; the TYPED v1 walk (_l3d_typed, imported and sha-pinned), the RELENC relation-name encodings against the population rows' frozen query vectors; the laptop run also asserts LEX / XA / UA identical to the E2 v1 record and UAG equal to its post-hoc derivation; UNROUTED and PHG_k432 / MTK_k432 with the ROWS mask; no model runs

inputs_on_the_host.query_vectors: data/final_canonical/metaqa/embeddings/{dense,splade}/queries/shard_0000{8,9} (pushed under the declaration and addendum 1); only the population rows are read

test.laptop: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python -u scratchpad/_l3d_e2b.py RUN metaqa v1 -> results/L3_DEV/l3e2b_metaqa__v1.{json,npz}
test.host: rx run -n l3h-e2b-h1 --cpus 2 --mem 3 --var OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=12 -- python -u scratchpad/_host_yield.py run -- python -u scratchpad/_l3h_run.py scratchpad/_l3d_e2b.py RUN metaqa h1 -> results/L3_DEV/l3e2b_metaqa__h1.{json,npz}
test.gate: BIT_IDENTICAL; then a dated addendum names the harness; until then its host output is a test artifact only

priority: the host job runs under the crag host-yield wrapper (results/HOST_YIELD/HOST_YIELD_POLICY__v1.json, addendum 8)
unchanged: the bundle, the runner, the BLAS setting of addendum 2, the authorizations' pins and every 'never' of the declaration
